name: shopsmart
description: Shopsmart monorepo — root scripts for E2E and aggregate lint

scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix client && npm run format:check --prefix server
scripts.e2e:servers: concurrently -k -s first -n api,client "npm run start --prefix server" "npx wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5001/api/health && npm run dev --prefix client -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173"
